newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish BOC unit starts PLN 100 mln CP plan.
newsitem.headline: Polish BOC unit starts PLN 100 mln CP plan.

text.p: The Polish unit of the British BOC Group, called BOC Gazy Ltd, started on October 4 a 100 million zloty commercial paper programme by selling the first, 15 million zloty tranche, the programme's manager said.

The Polish branch of the Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING) said in a statement the two- and three-month paper sold in the first tranche carried a yield of 18.65-18.7 percent and 18.8 percent respectively.
Under the programme BOC will issue paper with maturities from 30 to 360 days depending on investor needs. @
The next tranche of the scheme, fully guaranteed by Britain's BOC Group, is planned for later this month.
BOC Gazy Ltd, in which BOC Group has a 87.7 percent stake, had sales of 53 million zlotys in 1995 and expected them to rise to 70 million this year.
